messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx from private-vpc-gateway-prod-eu detected (22:17 UTC). 504/timeouts spike on /v1/infer. Error rate 2.3% over 15m window. Auto-page: @oncall-networking

oncall-networking: I'm acking, on my way. grabbing runbook and current topology. @maria-ops can you pull gateway health + recent infra changes?

maria-ops: looking. Metrics: NAT gateway 'nat-gw-eu-01' showing connection errors and high retransmits. No app deploys in last hour. Checking audit: terraform-auto applied a security-group change at 22:10 that restricted outbound traffic to ports 80/443 only (tx rules tightened). That could interact with peering.

kevin-sre: quick smoke from jumpbox to internal health endpoint: `curl -I https://inference.private.redwood/api/health`
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2026 22:20:05 GMT
Server: gateway
```

samir-net: I see BGP flaps on peering 'transit-peering-eu-az1' around 22:09-22:12 (3 flaps). traceroute from nat-appliance to egress next-hop shows intermittent hops: 10.0.12.1 -> * -> 10.0.20.5 (timeouts). Could be session churn causing conntrack churn.

jane-cs: support: 3 customers reported timeouts in EU, ticket refs CUST-824, CUST-907, CUST-915. Customers hit inference timeouts and fallbacks. Logged customer-impact count ~10k failed requests in 20m window.

maria-ops: options: 1) immediate rollback of SG change (terraform revert) 2) shift traffic to dedicated-egress-01 NAT pool while we validate rollback 3) bump conntrack on nat appliances as temporary mitigation. Rolling back SG is preferred but takes ~15m to plan/apply.

kevin-sre: I'll do a progressive route failover to dedicated-egress-01 to reduce blast radius. Doing 20% -> 50% increments. Command: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-abc --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --instance-id nat-xxxx` (executed via infra-runner).

deploy-bot: route update executed by kevin-sre at 22:28 UTC (req-id: f2a9-zz). Traffic shift to dedicated-egress-01 started.

oncall-networking: monitoring dashboards... error rate dropped to 0.8% within 3m of failover. Good signal. Keep observing for 10 min before rollback plan. Maria please prepare revert PR for the SG change and get it ready to merge. Also coordinate with CS for customer updates.

maria-ops: PR opened: #5786 "revert: tighten outbound sg on vpc/egress". Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/5786. Terraform plan looks clean. ETA apply ~15m after approvals.

kevin-sre: if revert doesn't fully resolve, next step is increasing conntrack on nat appliances: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and persist to /etc/sysctl.d/99-nf.conf. That's last-resort for scale.

jane-cs: notified impacted customers with temporary mitigation info and ETA. Offering proactive retries and suggested clients to use fallback endpoints.

maria-ops: PR merged at 22:42 UTC, terraform apply finished, security group rules rolled back to previous state. Re-applying config now.

oncall-networking: observing post-rollback metrics... 5xx down to baseline ~0.12% and tail latency normalized. We'll start shifting traffic back from dedicated-egress-01 to normal path.

kevin-sre: shifting routes back (in increments). route replace executed at 22:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: route restore executed by kevin-sre at 22:52 UTC (req-id: a8d3-yy).

oncall-networking: All clear on production panels, error rates stable. Marking paging clear in 10m after final verification. Thanks team.

samir-net: preliminary root cause hypothesis: transient peering BGP instability caused path churn, which increased connection resets through NAT. The outbound SG restriction reduced allowed egress diversity (blocked fallback ports/paths) amplifying failures into 504s. Will open network postmortem and link timeline + BGP logs + conntrack counters. Action items: add pre-merge egress smoke tests, add alert for BGP flaps, add guardrail to prevent terraform changes that narrow egress without canary.

maria-ops: follow-ups: PR#5790 to add egress smoke test in infra CI, RFC for automated rollback on critical infra changes, and runbook update for NAT conntrack scaling.

jane-cs: customer notes: CUST-824/907/915 updated, no further escalations. Will draft CS post-incident note.

oncall-networking: closing thread for now. Will collect logs and publish incident postmortem by EOD. :white_check_mark:
